headline: Safaricom Paid $125M in Spectrum Fees as Court Dispute Continues
summary: Kenya permits telecom operators to pay large spectrum fees over 10 years. Safaricom spent approximately US$125 million on licenses last year and is currently involved in a court dispute regarding annual fees.
why: Spectrum costs and regulatory fees represent major capital expenditures and operating expenses for telecommunications operators.

impacts.name: Safaricom
impacts.why: Spectrum licensing costs and legal disputes impact telecom cash flows and expenses.
